messages.author: 0b5254eeb9973d7a
messages.subject: Re: Getting System is Computationally singular when running Common factor DWLS model without SNPs
parts:
Hi Ravi,
Unless additional constraints are imposed, a common factor requires a minimum of 3 indicators for identification. A factor model with two indicators will have 1 factor variance, 2 factor loadings, and 2 residual variances. Standard identification constraints are to fix either a loading or the factor variance to 1.0. This leaves you with 4 free parameters. Your rG matrix however only has  3 pieces of information (1 genetic covariance and 2 genetic variances), so your model is under identified (df = -1). Additionally, the genetic correlation between your two variables is 1.0, which may lead to further issues.
I hope that helps.
Elliot
